items.place: Uchkaran area, Nanoor, Birbhum district, West Bengal
items.headline: Man in custody shot dead by Bengal police
items.text: Ratan Sheikh, arrested over the 13 Nov shooting of a constable, was killed in police firing on 15 Nov. Police say he fired at them while recovering a weapon. No probe into the death reported.

photo.alt: A small-town road lined with shops, parked motorbikes and an electric rickshaw under a hazy sky.
photo.caption: Paikar, a village market in Birbhum district, in January 2025. File photo of the district.

items.place: Firozpur Jhirka area, Nuh district, Haryana
items.headline: Two killed in Nuh police shootout
items.text: Sabir and Gabbar, suspected of cattle smuggling, died in a pre-dawn police shootout on 15 Nov; a third man is in hospital. Police say the men fired first; a magisterial inquiry has begun.

photo.alt: Open scrubland with dirt tracks seen from a rocky hill, with a town and trees in the haze beyond.
photo.caption: Tauru, in Nuh district, seen from the Aravalli hills in 2014. File photo of the district.

items.place: Chekkanurani police station, Madurai district, Tamil Nadu
items.headline: CB-CID summons police over Madurai station death
items.text: The CB-CID summoned the three suspended police over R Balakrishnan's death, and a magistrate held an inquiry at the station on 15 Nov. Police say suicide and released CCTV; the family alleges custodial killing.

photo.alt: A painted temple ceiling in red, blue and gold above carved stone pillars with lion figures.
photo.caption: A temple ceiling and carved pillars in Madurai, in 2011. File photo of the city.

items.headline: Statewide shutdown called over Naga killings
items.text: A Manipur committee called a 24-hour statewide shutdown from Sunday midnight, demanding arrests within three days over the four Naga civilians killed near New Haven. No official response reported.

photo.alt: Women vendors sit at stalls of vegetables and fish in a covered market, seen from above, as shoppers walk by.
photo.caption: Ima Keithel, Imphal's women-run market, in 2013. File photo of the city.

items.place: Bandipora, Bandipora district, Jammu and Kashmir
items.headline: Page operator arrested over Kulgam attack post
items.text: Bandipora police arrested the operator of a local Facebook page for allegedly posting false claims that three CRPF personnel died in the 11 Nov Kulgam attack. Police say the post could cause panic.

photo.alt: A lake covered in lily pads and flowers, with green hills and mountains under clouds behind.
photo.caption: Wular Lake in Bandipora district, in 2020. File photo of the district.

items.headline: El Obeid celebratory gunfire kills up to two
items.text: Gunfire, some from anti-aircraft weapons, celebrating false reports that the army took Al-Nuhud killed one or two people and injured 25 to 45+. Accounts differ on who fired; no official statement reported.

photo.alt: A wide road with street lights under a dark blue sky, a coach approaching and a man walking on the verge.
photo.caption: A main road in El Obeid, North Kordofan, in 2020. File photo of the city.

items.place: Chernihiv, Odesa and other regions, Ukraine
items.headline: Strikes kill four, injure 69 across Ukraine
items.text: Ukrainian authorities say strikes over one day killed four, two at an energy site in Mena, and injured 69. They report 132 drones; 41,000 Odesa families lost power. No Russian comment reported.

photo.alt: Two tall striped chimneys, one giving off white smoke, above a long industrial building in the haze.
photo.caption: Chernihiv's combined heat and power plant in 2005. File photo of the region's energy grid.

items.place: Muntinlupa and Liwasang Bonifacio, Metro Manila, Philippines
items.headline: Hundreds of marchers detained as ASEAN summit opens
items.text: Police held 209 to about 300 marchers in Muntinlupa (police and organiser counts) and several in Manila, where 12 were hurt. Police say the rallies lacked permits; a journalists' union reports 22 media workers harassed.

photo.alt: A wet city street beside a white monument plaza and trees, with a large 'Welcome to ASEAN Community' banner.
photo.caption: Liwasang Bonifacio plaza in Manila, with an ASEAN banner, in 2017. File photo of the protest site.

items.place: Burqin, near Jenin, occupied West Bank
items.headline: AFP video journalist detained near Jenin
items.text: Israeli troops detained AFP contributor Mohammad Ateeq in a 1:30am raid on 15 Nov, his wife says. The military says he is suspected of Hamas ties; AFP asks for evidence or his release.

photo.alt: A small stone church with a bell tower behind a paved courtyard with potted plants and pine trees.
photo.caption: The Church of St George in Burqin, near Jenin, in 2019. File photo of the village.

items.headline: Drone attacks on power grid darken Sudan's cities
items.text: At least 18 attacks hit power infrastructure in nine-plus states from 20 Oct to 2 Nov. The UN's Denise Brown says dialysis stopped and women give birth without light. No side has claimed them.

photo.alt: A satellite view of brown desert and the green line of the Nile, with a long dark plume of smoke drifting south.
photo.caption: A satellite image from January 2025 shows smoke from a fire at the Al-Jaili oil refinery, north of Khartoum. File image.
photo.credit: NASA Earth Observatory (MODIS, Aqua) / Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Officer questioned over Acre driver shooting
items.text: Israel's police watchdog questioned an off-duty Border Police officer who shot and seriously wounded a driver on 14 Nov; he was put under five days' house arrest. Police say the driver endangered pedestrians.

photo.alt: A narrow stone alley in an old town, with a man holding a bicycle, a woman walking and a stairway behind.
photo.caption: A street in Acre's Old City in 2011. File photo of the city. A child's face is blurred.

focus.title: Sudan's long war
focus.dek: Celebratory gunfire in El Obeid killed one or two; at least 18 drone attacks hit Sudan's power grid in two weeks. No official statement reported.
focus.alt: A wide road with street lights under a dark blue sky, a coach approaching and a man walking on the verge.
